additional_context: FHIR-38953 is the underlying Published/Persuasive with Modification refactor that removed quantitativeDetails and introduced ObservationDefinition.permittedUnit and ObservationDefinition.component.permittedUnit. source/fhir.ini confirms ObservationDefinition is active build-scope source. Remaining quantitativeDetails/customaryUnit strings are outside the requested narrative text, in a checked-in SVG diagram and the library model-info surface, and should be considered under a separate tracked decision if the work group wants broader non-narrative cleanup.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because source/observationdefinition/observationdefinition-introduction.xml already says ObservationDefinition can specify units allowed for valueQuantity by setting ObservationDefinition.permittedUnit, and the obsolete requested paragraph no longer appears in source.
